label: throughput-secondaries
_why: Two supply-side gaps in one run. (1) THROUGHPUT: Building.GetThroughputBonusCurrent/Target render the building panel's throughput row, so the realised bonus can be READ per building rather than summed from tech+law+company sub-factors or backed out of order differences - Belgium's steel runs 31% above base, mostly company bonuses. Probe-and-measure at once: the two calls are on their own line, so if they void they take only themselves and the inventory still lands. (2) SECONDARY PMs: the preset takes secondaries from history, and the game runs more - Belgium's fruit and luxury clothes have no source at all in the scenario though the buildings are present.
_note: until = 1836.6.1 so the phase-3 active_pms block (dump + 3 months) actually fires.
